title: ID0436323-DC/Si-D/DE-[Multiple]Change logo and operator name
description:
Reported behaviour/issue
For the following chargers, please remove the current logo on the start screen and insert the new logo in the attachment. Also, please change the operator name to moblty charging. Please pay attention to the small letters (i.e. no capital letters).
Solution: Requested changes made and no response from customer.
